Tools.Select: Select — click to select a shape; drag to move; drag the blue circle above the box to rotate; Escape to deselect
Tools.Text: Text (click to place; size follows brush-size slider × 8)

Actions.CopyFallback: Image opened in new tab - right-click to Copy Image
Actions.CopyFailed: Could not open new window. Please use Save as PNG instead.
Actions.LiveDraw: Go Live — broadcast drawing to all players in real time

Status.InkTooltip: Total ink used — sum of stroke lengths for every drawn element (1 ink = 1000 world-units of line). The spell level badge in the canvas corner is derived from this number.
Status.SpellLevelTooltip: Spell level this circle can hold, based on ink used

Gallery.Empty: No saved circles yet. Draw something and click the floppy-disk icon!

GM.DeleteConfirmBody: Remove "{name}" from the shared track registry? Players who already collected it keep it in their history, but it will no longer appear in the Jukebox.

Manager.Empty: No records registered yet. Use "Add Track" to create one.
Manager.ResetAllConfirmBody: Mark every record as uncollected for the whole party? The records themselves are kept — only the party's collection progress is cleared.
Manager.MarkCollected: Mark as collected for the party
Manager.MarkUncollected: Mark as uncollected for the party
Manager.CollectingEnableHint: Allow the party to collect records again
Manager.CollectingDisableHint: Stop the party from collecting records
Manager.CollectingOnHint: Players can pick up records from sounds, pickups and items.
Manager.CollectingOffHint: Players cannot collect any records; only you can grant them here.

Settings.CollectionEnabledHint: When off, players cannot collect any records from ambient sounds, map pickups or items. The GM can still grant records from the Music Tracks window.
Settings.RewardSoundHint: A short sound effect played for everyone whenever the party collects a new Jukebox track.

Launch.Title: Challenge to Dragonchess
Launch.Intro: Target one PC token and one NPC token before pressing this button. The PC's player will receive an invitation.
Launch.AlreadyRunningBody: A Dragonchess match is already in progress or awaiting a response. Starting a new one will replace it. Continue?
Launch.NeedTwoTargets: Target exactly two tokens first: one PC and one NPC.
Launch.NeedOnePcOneNpc: One targeted token must have a player owner (the PC) and the other must not (the NPC).
Launch.ChallengeConfirmBody: Challenge {opponent} to a game of Dragonchess?
Launch.NeedGmOnline: A GM must be logged in to referee a Dragonchess match.
Launch.NeedOneTarget: Target exactly one other player's token first, then control your own.
Launch.NeedOtherPlayerToken: The targeted token must belong to a different player.
Launch.NeedOwnToken: Control your own character's token first.
Launch.ChallengeSent: Challenge sent! Waiting for a response…
Launch.ChallengeBusy: A Dragonchess match is already running — try again once it's over.

Invite.Title: Dragonchess Challenge
Invite.Body: {challenger} challenges you to a game of Dragonchess: {pc} against {npc}. Do you accept?

Rps.PlayerBody: Choose your throw to see who picks their colour first.

Color.GmBody: You won the throw. Choose the NPC's colour.
Color.PlayerBody: You won the throw! Choose your colour — Blau moves first.

Notify.InvitationSent: {player} has been invited to a Dragonchess match: {pc} against {npc}.
Notify.RpsResult: {player} threw {pcChoice}, {npcChoice} was thrown for the NPC — {winner} wins the throw.
Notify.GameStart: Dragonchess begins: {pc} plays {pcColor}, {npc} plays {npcColor}. Blau moves first.
Notify.NoActiveGame: There is no Dragonchess game running right now.
Notify.EndStalemate: The game ends in a stalemate — a draw.
Notify.EndKingCaptured: {winner} wins — the enemy König has fallen!

Log.GameStart: The match begins — {pcColor} against {npcColor}. Blau moves first.
Log.KingAttack: {attacker} strikes down {defender} — an attack on the König always lands.
Log.CaptureSuccessLine: {attacker} defeats {defender} ({roll}) and takes the square, entrenched.
Log.CaptureFailLine: {attacker} falls to {defender} ({roll}) — {defender} holds the square, entrenched.
Log.PromotionLine: A Knappe reaches {square} and becomes a Drache!

Board.NoGame: There is no Dragonchess game to show.
Board.Waiting: Waiting for the invitation to be answered…
Board.Declined: The invitation to this Dragonchess match was declined.
Board.KingAttackBanner: {attacker} strikes at the König — {defender} has no defense against this…
Board.EndStalemate: Stalemate — the game is a draw.
Board.EndKingCaptured: {winner} wins — the enemy König has fallen!
Board.ResignConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to resign this Dragonchess match?
Board.EndGameBody: Declare a winner and end the match immediately.

Settings.DifficultyHint: Default difficulty offered when the GM launches a new Dragonchess match.
Settings.RollDelayHint: Seconds of suspense between a Schlagzug being announced and its outcome — time for the table to react. Set to 0 for no delay.
Settings.KingsMayTouchHint: The König cannot attack, so strictly it threatens no squares. Off (default) still bans the two Kings from standing adjacent, as in normal chess. On allows it.
